correctness.rationale: The K6 mnemonic reconstructs exactly 150 facets and face vector (16,120,330,375,150). Over F2 the 330 triangle boundaries have rank 104 while the complete one-skeleton has cycle-space dimension 105, so H1 has dimension one. All 230 nonface triples reduce to the same nonzero quotient vector. Independently, an explicit 45-edge cocycle evaluates zero on every face triangle and one on every missing triangle. All 720 S6 permutations induced on the six letters and ten bisections preserve the facet set and give exactly four missing-triangle orbits of sizes 20,60,90,60. The finite claim is exhaustive.

value.rationale: RP4_16 is the canonical vertex-minimal triangulation of real projective four-space, and its unique nonzero mod-two first-homology class is a fundamental topological feature. The result completely classifies the shortest simple representatives of that class and resolves their full automorphism-orbit structure. This is an intrinsic systolic invariant tied to the minimal triangulation and its symmetry, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
